text: {"name":"write_dash_header","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Writes a 28-byte DASH header from template data, patches its control word, and advances the caller's output cursor by 28 bytes.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"a1":"output_cursor_ref","v1":"dash_header_template","v2":"header_control_word","v7":"auxiliary_header_data"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Fixed marker byte 0x2D."},{"offset":1,"meaning":"Fixed protocol byte 0x1A."},{"offset":2,"meaning":"Control word sourced from the template with bits 2–4 replaced by 0b011."},{"offset":15,"meaning":"Copied template byte overwritten with zero."},{"offset":16,"meaning":"Copied template byte overwritten with zero."},{"offset":21,"meaning":"16-bit value copied from template bytes 32–33."},{"offset":23,"meaning":"Four bytes copied from a separate global source."},{"offset":27,"meaning":"Byte copied from template offset 40."}]}
